critique.evidence: Strong cyber-defense art direction, disciplined red/cyan/amber palette, crisp borders, and an excellent desktop headline establish clear identity and hierarchy. However, tablet and especially mobile compress dense mono labels, chart annotations, verdict copy, and mutation rows to near-microscopic sizes. The mobile vaccination stack becomes long and visually repetitive, while the desktop phylogeny graphic is too small relative to its large empty panel. The global header is polished on desktop but feels clipped rather than intentionally recomposed on tablet/mobile; the mobile version drops the brand name and exposes only a narrow navigation slice.
critique.fix: Increase small-text sizes and contrast at narrow widths, simplify secondary copy, redesign the vaccination sequence as a compact vertical timeline, enlarge/rebalance the desktop phylogeny visualization, and give tablet/mobile a purpose-built header with persistent brand identity and a clear menu or section indicator.
